answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it can vote, so influence costs real capital that a sybil farmer must multiply across every clone — a glacier of frozen funds that only thaws after honest seasons. The bond is held in escrow by the harbor authority: misbehavior burns it. The failure mode is a rich attacker treating bonds as a bulk purchase, so the check is to cap influence per bond and trace funding sources, freezing any cluster of deposits that flows from a single inlet of capital.
